digest.component_or_area: review-kernel cross-gate execution and provider cutover
propositions: A deterministic shadow comparator must consume the same observed call/result set as legacy and RP-06 projections and report exact field-level mismatches, accepting only an approved delta allowlist (effective retune/disable, project DET/LLM, code-review budget, typed partial-failure, success checkpointing).

Repository-policy/contract guards must fail when a review gate bypasses CriteriaSnapshot to read routing directly, when a second discovery scheduler is introduced outside the shared kernel, or when per-unit trace fields enter review/review-status schemas.

The cross-gate default path must be exercised through the real external LLM provider matrix, proving at least one discovery call reaches each configured provider and asserting narrow final verdicts (PASS/BLOCK) with internal trace retained and no secrets/prompts printed.

New code must ignore legacy checkpoint envelopes, the retained compatibility projection cannot write new envelopes or decide verdicts, and rollback requires only a code revert without journal rewrite or data cleanup.

docs/review-kernel.md must document final ownership (gate topology/strategy owned by gates, snapshot/execution facts shared, RP-01 owns provider-turn retry, rollback is code revert), approved deltas, sensitive-data boundary, shadow behavior, and revert-based rollback.

Live provider canary at tests/external/test_review_discovery_live.py with external+llm_live markers must drive the real default discovery path, assert narrow verdicts with coverage.llm_ran=true and sidecar_emitted=true, and print no secrets, prompt bodies, or trace.
